pcs.pc_description: collect information on the circumstances leading to the breakdown and recent history of repairs and maintenance done on the equipment with particular reference to engine and power train system
inspect the work area and ensure it is safe, clean and with adequate lighting and ventilation as per the safety regulations, to enable repairs to be carried out efficiently
inspect the machine for visible damages /deficiencies and leaks in the engine and power train system
check all levels of fuel, coolant and oils in engine, hydraulic and power train system; top up if necessary
start the engine as per procedure and check running to confirm the defect/fault reported in the engine and power train system
test the engine sub systems; like fuel -air, ignition, lubrication and cooling; sequentially using appropriate testing tools, aids like schematics and diagnostic equipment
test the engine control systems and instrument panels sequentially using appropriate testing tools, aids like schematics and diagnostic equipment
interpret the diagnostic results to identify the fault and its most likely causes as per the manufacturer service manual
ascertain the availability of necessary parts and consumables and prepare a proposed repair plan including approximate costing and time schedule for preliminary approval as applicable
remove the affected parts correctly without causing further damage to them and peripheral components

inspect the removed/disassembled parts, identify those that can be reused/repaired/ replaced as applicable and finalise the work order including revised costing if necessary and obtain approval before commencing work
replace or repair the affected parts as per procedure, test functionality on bench as applicable and refit / reassemble the same as per the manufacturers guidelines
start the engine as per procedure and test run to confirm the defect/fault has been rectified and all engine and related systems are working as per the laid down specifications and parameters
ascertain the recent repairs and maintenance done on the engine and power train system
start the engine as per procedure and test run for leakages, unusual noises and general performance to corroborate with operators feedback on the equipment
ascertain the availability of necessary parts and consummables and prepare a tentative maintenance plan including approximate costing and time schedule for approval as applicable

carry out all applicable maintenance / service tasks on the equipments engine and related systems as per manufacturers specifications and procedures, ensuring only genuine and approved parts and consumables are used
start the engine as per procedure and conduct a final test run to check the performance of engine and related systems are as per the laid down specifications and parameters
monitor and guide as necessary the junior mechanics regularly to ensure quality and safety of work being carried out
dispose the defective parts, consumables and waste as per the organizational policies & environmental regulations
complete and submit periodic / final reports and documentation as per the organisational policies and procedures

pcs.pc_description: comply with all latest/current workshop safety, personal health, security and environmental related regulations and guidelines
inspect the work area and ensure it is safe from hazards, clean and with adequate lighting and ventilation as applicable, to enable repairs to be carried out efficiently
use appropriate personal protective clothing and equipment for various tasks and work conditions as per regulations
lift or haul as necessary, various tools and equipment safely from stowage area to repair bay as per the laid down procedures
carry out all repairs and maintenance tasks safely and correctly as per the manufacturers workshop procedures and guidelines
store the tools and equipment, post usage, at the designated places and ensure they are not left behind in the repair bay
keep the work area free from clutter and spillage on a regular basis to maintain basic hygiene and cleanliness at all times
handle the storage and disposal of waste including hazardous materials as per the safety, health and environmental regulations
operate various types and grades of fire extinguishers, as per the laid down procedures
support in administering basic first aid at the spot and report to supervisor, as required, in case of an accident needing evacuation
respond promptly and appropriately to any accident / incident or emergency, within the limits of ones roles and responsibilities
report and record, as applicable, details related to operations, incidents or accidents, in a factually correct manner
